correctness.rationale: By Cayley–Hamilton in both characteristics, AB is nilpotent iff tr(AB)=0 and det(A)det(B)=0; no tacit trace constraint on AB is needed. Each nonzero nilpotent B has image=kernel a line L, and each of the q+1 lines supports q−1 such B. Thus the cone including 0 has q² elements. For invertible A, write B=u⊗ℓ with ker ℓ=L=span(u) for each nonzero candidate. Then tr(AB)=ℓ(Au)=0 precisely when A leaves L invariant. The fiber size is 1+(q−1) times the number of invariant lines (where the 1 counts B=0), i.e. 2q−1/1 for odd split/nonsplit and q²/q for even scalar/nonscalar. In characteristic two the unique square root of −det(A) gives the repeated eigenvalue, with one eigenline for a nonscalar; in odd characteristic, at fixed nonzero s=−det A the equation a²+bc=s gives q(q−1) solutions with b≠0, plus 2q or 0 with b=0 for square or nonsquare s. Multiplying by (q−1)/2 proves both odd multiplicities without centralizer tables. A=0 has q³ choices; for nonzero nilpotent A=E₁₂ the nontrivial linear trace condition is B₂₁=0, giving q² and annihilator size q. The two trace-zero, at-least-one-nilpotent incidences each have size H=q³+(q²−1)q² and overlap I=q²+(q²−1)q. Then 2H−I gives the common polynomial. Summing annihilator sizes over zero, nonzero nilpotent and invertible A gives 3q³−q²−q; subtraction factors as stated and any nonzero nilpotent 2×2 matrix has square zero. An independent exact enumeration in GF(8), using (AB)²=0 on 262144 ordered pairs, yielded 8520 nilpotent and 1464 zero products, with fiber multiplicities 441,70,1 at sizes 8,64,512. This is supplementary; the proof is for every prime power. The supplied checker was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: This is a count of ordered pairs, not distinct resulting matrices. No higher-dimensional or prescribed-nonzero-trace count is verified.

evidence: For two nonzero nilpotents the proportional case in Lopatin yields zero product, whereas an E₁₂/E₂₁ representative has nonzero trace product. Whole-ring multiplication by an invertible A is a bijection of the sampling space, eliminating variation in that case.

evidence: The invertible fibers are the trace-polar intersection with the rank-one nilpotent cone; projectively they count invariant lines on the projective line. Lopatin's type (1) orbits account for shared lines when both factors are nilpotent, and type (2) has distinct lines.

value.rationale: The trace-zero slice is the canonical trace kernel and, in dimension two, is exactly where nilpotent factors coincide with the singular ones. It is not an arbitrarily chosen matrix subset. The exact conditional incidence reveals strong arithmetic heterogeneity, including forced zero as the only right factor for nonsplit invertible A in odd characteristic, while the aggregate nilpotent probability is uniform as a polynomial across characteristics. Separating actually zero products from nonzero nilpotent outcomes makes the census usable as a finite-field calibration and not a recomputation of whole-ring probabilities.
residual_risks: The value is the natural exact low-dimensional classification, not novelty of elementary eigenline or quadratic incidence arguments or significance in all dimensions.
